facts.text: Audrey signed up for a workshop about bonding with her pets next month.

evidence.quote: I signed up for a workshop about bonding with my pet next month.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the workshop is a positive reinforcement training class.

evidence.quote: I saw this workshop flyer at my local pet store. It was a positive reinforcement training class and I wanted to give it a shot.

facts.text: Audrey believes her dogs will catch on quickly to the training methods.

evidence.quote: I'm sure they'll catch on really quick! They're quick learners and love rewards!

facts.text: Audrey met a friendly and playful dog at her local pet store when she saw the workshop flyer.

evidence.quote: The volunteer in the store was nice enough to let me meet their dog – he was so friendly and playful!
